bullets.title: Starlink Direct-to-Cell: Jefferies expert call flags tower operator risk next week
bullets.body: Jefferies is hosting an expert call assessing Starlink Direct-to-Cell threats to terrestrial network operators and tower company economics. Key debate points include LEO technical limitations vs. ground-based networks on coverage, capacity, cost, and replacement cycles — with consensus leaning toward a complementary rather than replacement role for satellite.

bullets.title: Macro data point: June NFP soft at 54k; U-rate dips to 4.2%
bullets.body: BofA LatAm note flagged the US June jobs report: nonfarm payrolls came in at 54k (soft), unemployment rate fell to 4.2%, and the 3-month average stands at 111k. Soft labor data is relevant context for Fed path and risk positioning heading into next week.
